<compartment start="160" end="168" title="Manual page rotation escape hatch" episode_type="feature,bug" importance="27">
<p1>
Started by trying to auto-rotate ugly multi-scan uploads in the docket OCR intake, then backed away from making low-confidence guesses.
U: if confidence is fuzzy, give support a knob instead of guessing.

ingest/api/src/routes/upload.ts now stores an optional per-page rotation override alongside the upload manifest, and web/src/components/PageRotationOverride.tsx gives support a manual control in triage. Automatic rotation only applies when the OCR angle model is confidently right; the rest stay untouched until a human steps in. docs/support/scan-triage.md covers when to use the override. Commit 7ab2c54.
</p1>
<p2>
The rotation fix became a support-side escape hatch, not aggressive automation.
U: if confidence is fuzzy, give support a knob instead of guessing.

ingest/api/src/routes/upload.ts persists per-page overrides, web/src/components/PageRotationOverride.tsx exposes them in triage, and auto-rotation stays gated behind a high confidence threshold.
</p2>
<p3>
Low-confidence scan rotation is now handled through a manual override path, with automation reserved for only the most certain OCR angle predictions.
</p3>
<p4>PageRotationOverride; upload manifest override; angle_confidence threshold</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* OCR angle predictions below a high confidence threshold are not reliable enough for unattended page rotation on messy multi-scan uploads.
</CONSTRAINTS>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* Automatic rotation threshold: angle_confidence 0.98 or higher.
</CONFIG_VALUES>
</facts>
<events>
<trajectory_correction at_compartment="19">
  <summary>Changed scan rotation from auto-fix ambition to manual override with high-confidence automation only.</summary>
  <before_strategy>Use OCR angle predictions to auto-rotate problematic scans broadly during ingest.</before_strategy>
  <correction_source>user</correction_source>
  <correction_signal>U: if confidence is fuzzy, give support a knob instead of guessing.</correction_signal>
  <after_strategy>Persist per-page rotation overrides and reserve automatic rotation for only high-confidence predictions.</after_strategy>
  <evidence>The final implementation added PageRotationOverride in triage UI and left ingest auto-rotation behind a strict confidence gate.</evidence>
</trajectory_correction>
</events>
<user_observations>
* User accepts deterministic manual escape hatches faster than vague low-confidence automation when support burden is obvious.
</user_observations>

<compartment start="1" end="12" title="Tenant context from membership" episode_type="design,feature" importance="92">
<p1>
Worked through the tenant-auth boundary in LedgerLeaf after the API still accepted orgId from the browser on a couple of older endpoints.
U: never trust orgId from the browser.
U: membership can change mid-session; revocation has to bite immediately.

In apps/api/src/middleware/tenant-context.ts I added TenantContextResolver.resolveFromSession(), changed services/auth/src/session.ts to sign active_membership_id instead of tenant_id, and removed the last direct req.body.orgId reads from apps/api/src/routes/projects.ts and apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts. Internal fan-out calls now forward x-ledgerleaf-tenant-id after middleware resolution rather than letting downstream services re-parse cookies. Commit a14c9e2.

Closed it with integration coverage in apps/api/test/tenant-guard.revocation.test.ts: user loses membership, refreshes nothing, and the next request is denied because the middleware rehydrates tenant and role from membership state. Also named the new boundary pieces TenantGuard and TenantContextResolver so future auth work lands in one place.
</p1>
<p2>
Moved LedgerLeaf auth to server-resolved tenant context in apps/api/src/middleware/tenant-context.ts and stopped trusting browser-provided orgId on the remaining old endpoints.
U: never trust orgId from the browser.
U: membership can change mid-session; revocation has to bite immediately.

Sessions now carry active_membership_id, middleware rebuilds tenant and role per request, and downstream services consume x-ledgerleaf-tenant-id only after TenantGuard resolution. Added revocation coverage so stale tabs stop working immediately after membership removal.
</p2>
<p3>
Tenant authorization now flows from membership state rather than browser-selected tenant IDs. The durable decision was to keep tenant and role out of client-controlled request surfaces and rebuild them server-side on each authenticated hop.
</p3>
<p4>active_membership_id; TenantGuard; TenantContextResolver; x-ledgerleaf-tenant-id</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<PROJECT_RULES>
* New authenticated handlers must derive tenant access from server-resolved membership state, never from request body, query, or cookie tenant IDs.
* Any endpoint bypassing TenantGuard needs an explicit integration test covering membership revocation.
</PROJECT_RULES>
<ARCHITECTURE>
* Session tokens carry user_id and active_membership_id; tenant and role are rehydrated server-side so revocation and membership changes apply without waiting for session expiry.
* Billing, files, and audit services consume a middleware-built TenantContext instead of parsing auth material independently.
</ARCHITECTURE>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* Browser-supplied orgId values are unsafe for tenant authorization because users can belong to multiple tenants and stale tabs can replay old selections.
</CONSTRAINTS>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* Internal tenant hop header: x-ledgerleaf-tenant-id.
* Auth claim name: active_membership_id.
</CONFIG_VALUES>
<NAMING>
* The auth boundary middleware is named TenantGuard and the resolver behind it is TenantContextResolver.
</NAMING>
</facts>
<user_observations>
* User frames security questions as trust-boundary rules and wants the unsafe source named explicitly.
</user_observations>

<compartment start="95" end="110" title="CRDT ordering by Lamport site" episode_type="design,refactor,investigation" importance="72">
<p1>
Started CollabPad reconnect handling by sorting incoming ops with server receivedAt. U: "server time feels simpler; prove it doesn't lie"

The offline-client replay test proved it did lie: a browser tab could reconnect over WebRTC with buffered edits older than a websocket ack, and the server would assign a later receivedAt that inverted causality. U: "ok, make the doc clock the story, not the transport"

Refactored packages/collab/src/oplog.ts and packages/collab/src/sync/replay.ts to order by (lamport, site_id), with receivedAt kept only for telemetry. Renamed clientId to site_id in the wire schema because tabs, workers, and imported offline bundles are separate editing sites even when they share an account. Commit b44e0d9.
</p1>
<p2>
CollabPad abandoned receivedAt ordering after the reconnect test showed it inverted offline edits. U: "make the doc clock the story, not the transport"; ops now order by (lamport, site_id).
</p2>
<p3>
CollabPad CRDT ordering now follows document clocks rather than server receive time.
</p3>
<p4>lamport site_id; receivedAt telemetry only; reconnect replay</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<ARCHITECTURE>
* CollabPad orders CRDT operations by (lamport, site_id); server receivedAt is telemetry only.
</ARCHITECTURE>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* WebRTC reconnect can deliver buffered CollabPad ops older than a websocket ack, so receivedAt cannot be used as causal order.
</CONSTRAINTS>
<NAMING>
* CollabPad's editing-site field is named site_id rather than clientId because multiple browser contexts can share one account.
</NAMING>
</facts>
<events>
<trajectory_correction at_compartment="10">
  <summary>Changed CollabPad op ordering from server time to document clocks.</summary>
  <before_strategy>Sort reconnect replay operations by server receivedAt.</before_strategy>
  <correction_source>test_result</correction_source>
  <correction_signal>The offline-client replay test showed receivedAt inverted edits buffered over WebRTC.</correction_signal>
  <after_strategy>Order operations by lamport and site_id, keeping receivedAt only for telemetry.</after_strategy>
  <evidence>The final patch refactored oplog.ts and replay.ts around (lamport, site_id).</evidence>
</trajectory_correction>
</events>
<user_observations>
* User asks for simple designs but accepts added machinery when a test demonstrates the simpler model is false.
</user_observations>
</compartment_examples_from_other_projects>

<compartment start="758" end="765" title="调度误判纠正与 3.1 序列化根因：fix-7 实为在世，fix-11 取消" episode_type="investigation,bug" importance="64">
<p1>
我犯了一个调度错误，必须立即纠正：C3 终结结果来自 `ses_f691154aaffeSnoEs1O0TawKbU`——那正是我判定"已死"并重派掉的 **fix-7**。它其实活着，只是在长时间读码核实（14 个 schema × 契约 + `CareProjections`/`CareQueryService`/`CareLedgerService`/`CareAdmissionService` + `V1__create_tables.sql` 的 NOT NULL 列），10 分钟无写入属正常；我在 04:41 探测到 `requiredProperties` 命中 0 便断定零产出，而它 04:42:44 就落盘了。后果：我派出的 fix-11 仍在同一文件 `CareApiDocs.java` 上运行，构成重复写者——正是我本会话早期造成过实际损害、之后一直刻意避免的情形。

立即处置：`task_cancel` 取消已属多余的 fix-11（目标已被完成、与更安全的计划冲突），然后检查文件是否已被污染。取消返回"did not stay stopped"但状态已非 running；磁盘 **QUIESCENT**（60 秒指纹一致）。污染对账**干净**：`requiredProperties` 方法声明恰 **1** 次、`import java.util.Set;` 恰 1 次、`structuredKeys` 1 次、类声明 1 次，文件 mtime 仍是 **04:42:44**、大小 96727 ⇒ **fix-11 从未写入该文件**，无重复方法、无部分改动需回滚。14 个键各命中 **2** 次已确认无重复（`:811` 在 `propertyDocs()`、`:1070` 在 `requiredProperties()`，三方法分别在 `:538/:1016/:1067`）。

中央验证链全绿：`test-compile` **rc=0**、`ApiDocsApplierTest` **22/0/0** ⇒ fix-9 的 fixture 修复生效、硬化门禁 **GATE_RC=0 / 1/0/0 / BUILD SUCCESS**（33 项归零，跳过并披露 5 个无契约对应者）、全量 Java **442 run / 0 failures / 0 errors**（435 + fix-9 新增 7 项，账目自洽）。Board 已清空。

抓取最终真实文档并跑 `verify-r4.py`：**64 PASS / 2 FAIL**，两个失败项正是 fix-9 声称已修、且有通过测试的那一条：`SkinReportListItem.reportSummary` 与 `M4A04Metadata.reportedMicrocrystalState` 在真实文档中**仍缺 `"type":"object"`**（实测节点含 `properties`/`additionalProperties`/description，唯独无 `type`），而 `MicrocrystalObservationBody.state` 有。jar 确为新构建（423777 字节 ≠ 上轮 415676），故**不是抓取陈旧**。这意味着一个可信度缺口：单测 `refClearedFreeFormGetsObjectType` 通过（22/0/0），但真实路径未生效 ⇒ **fixture 与真实形态在关键处并不同形**，该测试没有代表性。

我不接受"测试绿了就等于修好了"，直接读实现与真实节点形态对比定位。根因：`MicrocrystalObservationBody.state` 是 `@NotNull Map<String,Object>` → 内联 object，真实输出含 `type`；而 `reportSummary`/`reportedMicrocrystalState` 是 **`JsonNode`** → springdoc 生成 `$ref: JsonNode`，引擎 `:581` 确实调用了 `prop.setType("object")` 且单测断言 `getType()=="object"` **通过** ⇒ **内存里设置成功，但 3.1 序列化未输出**。即对"`$ref` 形态的 `Schema` 实例"调用 `setType` 不体现在 3.1 序列化结果中；而引擎自己 `new ObjectSchema()` 构造的 schema 确实带 `"type":"object"`。两个结论：①修法有据——不要原地 mutate，应把父 schema 的该属性**替换为引擎构造的 `ObjectSchema`/`ArraySchema`**；②更严重的是**测试代表性缺陷**：该单测断言内存态 `getType()`，因此生产 JSON 缺 type 时它依然绿，给出的是**虚假保证**。严重度如实定级：属性已有 `properties` + `additionalProperties`，JSON Schema 语义无歧义、Swagger UI 可正常展开 ⇒ 属**规范卫生级**缺陷，不是客户端破坏性问题；但既然我自己提出且子道声称已修，就不能带着"已修"的表述交付。回弹 fix-9（引擎与其测试的作者），要求以**序列化后的 JSON** 为断言对象。

Board 再次不一致（`Active/Unreconciled: none`，但我派的任务返回 `running`，fix-9 也不在 Reusable）。本轮我授权了 fix-9 自行跑构建与测试，故不仅不能重派，还**绝不能并发跑 mvn**（会争用 `target/` 与端口、污染双方结果）。三重证据一度指向"尚未产出"（`task_status` 返回 "Unknown task ID or alias"、Board 两列表无、磁盘零写入、无 mvn 进程），但**我不能据此重派**：fix-7 当年也是同样信号，我重派后造成同文件重复写者。成本不对称明确——多等几分钟代价极低，重复写者代价高。故用**更长窗口**（约 4 分钟、三点指纹 + 构建进程探测）再探，判定 **STILL WRITING**：`ApiDocsApplier.java` 于 04:56:39 写入（57938→59851 字节）、`ApiDocsApplierTest.java` 连续三次增长（60743→62230→62660）、surefire 报告 05:00:14–15 新写入 ⇒ 它正在执行我授权的定向测试。这是**第八次**"簿记称死、实则在世"，也是**第二次**（继 fix-7 之后）如果我据此重派就会制造同文件重复写者。我这次选择更长窗口探测而非行动，避免了重犯。
</p1>
<p2>
我犯了一个调度错误：C3 终结结果来自 `ses_f691154aaffe…`——正是我判死并重派的 **fix-7**，它其实在长时间读码核实、10 分钟无写入属正常，04:42:44 就落盘了；我 04:41 探测 `requiredProperties` 命中 0 便断定零产出。后果是 fix-11 仍在 `CareApiDocs.java` 上运行，构成重复写者。立即 `task_cancel` 取消 fix-11 并取证：磁盘 QUIESCENT、`requiredProperties`/import/`structuredKeys`/类声明各恰 1 次、mtime 仍 04:42:44 ⇒ fix-11 从未写入，零污染无需回滚。中央验证全绿：`test-compile` rc=0、`ApiDocsApplierTest` 22/0/0、门禁 GATE_RC=0/1/0/0、全量 Java 442/0/0。`verify-r4.py` 却 **64 PASS/2 FAIL**——`reportSummary`/`reportedMicrocrystalState`（`JsonNode` 生成 `$ref`）仍缺 `type`，而 `state`（内联 object）有；jar 确为新构建 ⇒ 单测通过但真实路径未生效，**fixture 与真实不同形、测试没有代表性**。根因：引擎 `:581` 调了 `setType("object")`、内存态断言通过，但 `$ref` 形态实例的 setType 不进入 3.1 序列化。修法应整体替换属性实例而非原地 mutate；同时该测试给的是**虚假保证**。回弹 fix-9 要求以序列化 JSON 为断言对象。Board 再次 Active: none 而我派的任务 running；三重证据一度指向零产出，但我不重派（fix-7 教训），改用更长窗口探测判定 **STILL WRITING**（04:56:39 引擎写入、测试连续增长、surefire 05:00 新写）⇒ **第八次**簿记假信号、**第二次**若重派就会制造重复写者。
</p2>
<p3>
我因误判 fix-7 死亡而重派造成同文件重复写者，取消 fix-11 并实测对账确认零污染；中央验证全绿（442/0/0）但 `verify-r4.py` 报 2 FAIL，根因是 `$ref` 形态实例的 `setType` 不进入 OpenAPI 3.1 序列化，且原单测只断言内存态给出虚假保证——回弹 fix-9 改为序列化层断言。
</p3>
<p4>
fix-7 实为在世 (04:42:44 落盘); fix-11 取消零污染; verify-r4 64/2; JsonNode $ref 形态 setType 不序列化; 442/0/0
</p4>
</compartment>

<compartment start="766" end="771" title="3.1 序列化修复交付：整体替换属性实例，提交 7461ce1 送 Oracle 第三轮" episode_type="bug,feature" importance="62">
<p1>
fix-9 交付了**字节码级根因**的高质量修复，我的定位被证实且被深化：OpenAPI 3.1 的 `Schema31Mixin` 把 `getType()` 标为 `@JsonIgnore`，`"type"` 实际由 `getTypes()`（`Set<String>`）经 `TypeSerializer` 输出；而 `Schema.setType(String)` 只写 legacy `type` 字段、**不动 `types`**，原 `$ref` 形态实例 `types==null` ⇒ 原地 `setType` 永不进入 3.1 JSON。反之 `new ObjectSchema()` 走 `Schema.<init>("object", null)` 会 `addType("object")` ⇒ 正常。它还给出一个漂亮的反证：若生产用 3.0 序列化器，`getType()` 不会被忽略、`reportSummary` 就会带 type——**症状本身即证明生产走 3.1 路径**。修法为"整体替换属性实例"（新增 `FreeFormTarget` holder 携带父+键+原实例，`:551` 改 `applyFreeForm(FreeFormTarget,…)`、`:605` `copySiblingKeywords` 保留 `nullable/readOnly/writeOnly/deprecated/title/format/extensions` 与插入位置，`:602` `target.parent().getProperties().put(target.propertyName(), replacement)`）；测试改为对 `Json31.mapper()` 的**序列化结果**断言，并新增**负向判别力证明**（构造 `new Schema<>().$ref(...)` → 清 `$ref` → `setType("object")` → 序列化后断言 `type` **缺失**，证明新断言能捕获原缺陷而非恒真）。它还如实披露中途一次自测失败源于自己测试路径写错（`flex` 在 `state.properties` 下）。

按纪律**不采信自报**，跑完整中央验证链，全绿且我亲自复核关键节点：`test-compile` **rc=0**；定向文档测试 **34/0/0**（Guard 7 + Coverage 1 + DisabledIT 1 + **Applier 22** + OpenApiDocsIT 3）；**全量 Java 442 run / 0 failures / 0 errors，BUILD SUCCESS**；重建 jar、临时实例 5s UP、`/v3/api-docs` **200 / 423892 字节**、swagger-ui 200、用毕端口空闲无遗留进程；**`verify-r4.py` = 66 PASS / 0 FAIL，`VERIFY_RC=0`**（该脚本已自测有判别力：对修复前抓取为 34/22）。两个先前失败节点现已 `type='object'`、`$ref=None`，与对照项 `state` 形态一致；`JsonNode` 已修剪、schemas 61、384 个 `$ref` 零悬空。

提交本轮代码：**`7461ce115e2d3690c414db63bcd1bc261b95c8b1`**（9 文件全在 `web/docs/**`；整轮相对 dev 基线 `76cd426` 共 **12 文件 / +7224 −53**，`git diff --check` rc=0）。树中只剩 3 份交付文档（留待 Oracle 后 report-only 提交）。送 Oracle 第三轮**窄范围**复审——严格限定在它自己上轮声明的边界内（"下一轮只需核验递归自由结构 schema、响应 required 门禁及上述明确负向测试；已闭合的 7 项无需复审"），外加我自行发现并修复的序列化层缺陷。趁其复审，把两份交付文档补到当前事实：`B.md` 新增 **14.10 节**（第四轮整改落地、接缝风险实测裁定、3.1 序列化层缺陷的字节码级根因与修法、**测试代表性缺陷=虚假保证**及其负向判别力证明、33 项响应 required 补齐裁定与逐字段存在性核实、我对不可实现判据的自我纠正、绑定 `7461ce1` 的全部实测数字，以及**我本轮最实质的一次调度误判**——把处于长时间读码阶段的 C3 道判死并重派、造成同文件重复写者，随后取消并实测对账确认零污染无需回滚，连同另外三处工具/方法缺陷）；`B-oracle.md` **4.16.3** 同步填实，只留第十五轮 VERDICT 一行待填。我授权了 ora-1 自行跑定向测试（可用 18083 与 55435），故不并发跑 mvn 或起实例。
</p1>
<p2>
fix-9 交付字节码级根因修复：OpenAPI 3.1 的 `Schema31Mixin` 把 `getType()` 标 `@JsonIgnore`，`"type"` 由 `getTypes()` 经 `TypeSerializer` 输出，而 `Schema.setType(String)` 只写 legacy 字段、不动 `types`，`$ref` 形态实例 `types==null` ⇒ 原地 setType 永不进入 3.1 JSON；`new ObjectSchema()` 会 `addType` 故正常。修法为整体替换属性实例（新增 `FreeFormTarget` holder 携带父+键+原实例、`copySiblingKeywords` 保留兄弟关键字与插入位置、`:602` put 回父 properties）；测试改为对 `Json31.mapper()` 序列化结果断言并新增负向判别力证明（构造 `$ref` 实例清 `$ref`+setType 后断言序列化缺 `type`）。我按纪律跑完整中央验证：`test-compile` rc=0、定向文档测试 34/0/0、全量 Java 442/0/0、重建 jar 后 `/v3/api-docs` 423892 字节、swagger-ui 200、端口空闲、**`verify-r4.py` 66 PASS/0 FAIL**（对修复前为 34/22）。提交 **`7461ce1`**（9 文件全在 `web/docs/**`，整轮 12 文件/+7224−53）。送 Oracle 第三轮窄范围复审；趁此填 `B.md` 14.10 与 `B-oracle.md` 4.16.3（含我本轮最实质的调度误判），只留 VERDICT 待填。
</p2>
<p3>
fix-9 交付字节码级根因的序列化层修复（整体替换属性实例、序列化层断言 + 负向判别力证明）；我中央验证全绿（442/0/0、`verify-r4.py` 66/0）并提交 `7461ce1` 送 Oracle 第三轮。
</p3>
<p4>
Schema31Mixin getType @JsonIgnore / getTypes TypeSerializer; 整体替换属性实例 FreeFormTarget; 7461ce1; verify-r4 66/0; 423892 字节
</p4>
</compartment>

我最初判断：若 base `application.yml` 已给 `app.providers.mode` 设默认值，把 `@Profile({"dev","test"})` 换成 `@ConditionalOnProperty(mode=doubles)` 就是纯 Java 解法（`local` 继承 base 默认值），无需触碰任何配置文件。取证推翻了这个方向并给出决定性事实：base `application.yml:72` **已有** `app.providers.mode: ${APP_PROVIDERS_MODE:doubles}`（默认与 profile 无关），`prod` 段（:132-133）才设 `mode: real`；`TestDoubleProvidersConfig` **本来就没有 `@Profile`**，只有 `@ConditionalOnProperty(mode=doubles, matchIfMissing=true)` ⇒ 它不该因 `local` 失配；真正被 profile 门住的是 `IdentityProvidersConfig:19`（只有 `@Profile({"dev","test"})`、无 mode 条件）与 `DeviceProofDoublesConfig:14`（`@Profile`+mode 双重门）。
